scripts.install:all: bun install && cd backend && bun install && bunx prisma generate && cd ../frontend && bun install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "magenta,cyan" "cd backend && bun run dev" "cd frontend && bun run dev"
scripts.dev:init: bun run db:setup && bun run dev
scripts.test:all: cd backend && bun test && cd ../frontend && bun run test
